summary: Frontend-only validation of the new hover preview (MiniPreview/HoverCard) for table-type variables in the Email Templates editor on /settings. Login (admin), expand 'Plantillas Sede Pyme', open 'edit-template-quote_sent_PYME', and verify hover behavior on chips. All 6 acceptance criteria from the review request PASS.

issues: Console hydration warnings: '<span> cannot be a child of <tbody>' and '<tr> cannot be a child of <span>'. Pre-existing — NOT caused by this change (it shows on settings BEFORE the templates editor is even opened). Likely from some other table in the layout/sidebar. Worth tracking but not blocking.

T4_Nombre_Cliente_no_preview.result: PASS (non-table variables correctly have no HoverCard)

test_results_detail.T6_visual_evidence: Screenshots confirm both HoverCards render as actual styled <table> with the example data (Banco Mercantil/Banesco rows; Sucursal Norte/Sur + Total row).

critical_code_review_comments: EmailTemplatesEditor.jsx has VARIABLE_PREVIEW_HTML duplicated: once at module scope (L566-568) used by MiniPreview, and again inside a render block at L824-826 with slightly different padding/font-size. Recommend extracting to a single constant to avoid drift.
EmailTemplatesEditor.jsx is reaching a sizeable footprint (>1370 lines). Consider splitting MiniPreview, VARIABLE_PREVIEW_HTML and the variable-panel sub-tree into their own files.
Pre-existing hydration warnings on /settings (span inside tbody / tr inside span) are unrelated to this change but should be tracked separately.
seed_data_creation: None — read-only hover validation. Click test inserted placeholder into editor body but dialog was not saved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Editor opens via [data-testid=edit-template-quote_sent_PYME] after expanding 'Plantillas Sede Pyme'. HoverCards exposed via data-testid=var-preview-<key>. Open delay ~150ms; use wait_for_timeout(500) after hover() to be safe. Note that hovering one chip then the next: move the mouse to (10,10) between hovers to let the previous HoverCard close.
